interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to listen on for RARP requests. Each entry specifies the interface name and optionally its hardware (MAC) address.

name.description: Name of the network interface (e.g., eth0)

hwaddr.description: Optional hardware (MAC) address of the interface. If omitted, rarpd will detect it automatically.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file where rarpd will store its process ID.

strict_mode.description: If true, only respond to RARP requests from MAC addresses listed in static_entries. If false, respond to any request on configured interfaces.

static_entries.description: Optional static RARP mappings (MAC address to IPv4 address). Required in strict_mode or for pre-announced mappings.

hwaddr.description: Hardware (MAC) address in colon-separated hex format (e.g., 00:11:22:33:44:55)

ipv4.description: IPv4 address to map to the MAC address (e.g., 192.168.1.10)
